definitions.explanation: The state of not taking part in an event, activity, or organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不参加|ふさんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表明|ひょうめい}→表明：14052_hyoumei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They announced their non-participation in the meeting.

examples.japanese: {不参加|ふさんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: To state the reason for non-participation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不参加|ふさんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。

notes:
The state of not taking part in an event, activity, or organization.

FORMS:
⟦{不|ふ}→不：noentry⟧ (non-/un-) + ⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧ (participation)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不参加|ふさんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表明|ひょうめい}→表明：14052_hyoumei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to announce non-participation
- {不参加|ふさんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧: reason for non-participation
- {不参加|ふさんか}⟦{国|こく}→国：02204_kuni⟧: non-participating country
- {不参加|ふさんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide not to participate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧: participation (antonym)
- ⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧: absence (from a meeting/class — implies one was expected to attend)
- ⟦{棄権|きけん}→棄権：16194_kiken⟧: abstention (from a vote or competition)

{不参加|ふさんか} is a deliberate choice not to participate, while ⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧ may be due to circumstances.
